svg.title: How NAS files and Jellyfin data reach the container
svg.desc: On the Pi 5 everything outside /storage is read-only or lost on reboot. The NAS share (/volume1/media over NFS or SMB) is mounted at /storage/nas/media by the systemd unit storage-nas-media.mount. The Jellyfin container gets three bind mounts: /storage/nas/media as /media (read-only), /storage/docker/jellyfin/config as /config and /storage/docker/jellyfin/cache as /cache. With host networking it answers at http://192.168.1.3:8096.

g.text: everything outside /storage is read-only or lost on reboot
